settings.custom_css: selector{direction:rtl}selector .elementor-field-group>label,selector .elementor-field-label{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#adc6ff;margin-bottom:8px}selector .elementor-field-required-indicator{color:#e31837}selector .elementor-field-textual,selector textarea.elementor-field{background:#201f1f!important;color:#e5e2e1!important;border:none!important;border-bottom:2px solid #5d3f3e!important;border-radius:0!important;font-family:'Hanken Grotesk',sans-serif;font-size:16px;padding:12px 16px;box-shadow:none!important;direction:rtl}selector .elementor-field-textual:focus,selector textarea.elementor-field:focus{border-bottom-color:#e31837!important;box-shadow:0 2px 0 0 #e31837!important;outline:none}selector .elementor-field::placeholder,selector textarea.elementor-field::placeholder{color:#ad8886}selector .elementor-field-subgroup{max-height:300px;overflow-y:auto;border:1px solid #5d3f3e;background:#201f1f;padding:4px 16px;display:block;direction:rtl}selector .elementor-field-subgroup .elementor-field-option{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}selector .elementor-field-subgroup label{font-size:19px!important;color:#e5e2e1;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Hanken Grotesk',sans-serif}selector .elementor-field-subgroup input[type=checkbox]{width:24px;height:24px;accent-color:#e31837;flex:none;cursor:pointer}selector .elementor-button{background:#e31837!important;color:#fff!important;font-family:'Anton',sans-serif!important;font-style:italic;font-size:22px;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:0!important;padding:16px 40px}selector .elementor-button:hover{background:#4b8eff!important}
